edition_angle: Exploring how targeted botanical compounds modulate nuclear receptor signaling and adult neurogenesis to counter Alzheimer's-related cognitive impairment.

assignments.angle: Isoacteoside targets the orphan nuclear receptor TLX to stimulate adult neural stem cell proliferation and alleviate amyloid-beta-induced cognitive deficits.
assignments.reason: This study demonstrates a specific, mechanistic pathway (TLX nuclear receptor targeting) by which a botanical compound (isoacteoside) promotes neurogenesis and reverses amyloid-beta cognitive damage in an animal model, satisfying the requirement for concrete physiological mechanisms.
